plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 全局高度与 abc · JA-0062 · 为每个 ε 选择统一合适大小的辅助素数
plain_statement.en: New route · Global heights and abc · JA-0062 · Select the size of an auxiliary prime uniformly for each ε

brief.zh: 用素数无界和有理函数趋零。具体曲线上的可用性须由算术高度上界承担。
brief.en: Use unbounded primes and decay of the rational function. The height estimate must account for admissibility on actual curves.
